tasks.prompt: Write your 1-min self-intro in Chinese characters with Jyutping (5–6 lines: name, study, data work, why this job, thanks). Record one take, listen back, fix one tone (watch 面試 min6 si3, 時間 si4 gaan3, 職位 zik1 wai6), then re-record once.

questions.explain: min6 si3: low level, then mid level (試 = test).

questions.q: Thanking a waiter who brings water:
questions.explain: 唔該 for a service; 多謝 for a gift or favour.

questions.q: Jyutping for 因為 (with tone numbers, space between syllables).
questions.explain: jan1 wai6, high level then low level.
事 si6 low level. 試 si3, 時 si4.

questions.q: 我覺得呢個職位好適合我 means…
options: I think this role suits me well.
I want to join your team.

hap6 zok3; 作 zok3 as in 工作 gung1 zok3.
